principles: Do not fabricate unavailable market data.
Keep market data separate from news evidence.
Each asset vertical must earn production status independently.
Unified News Intelligence is the final shared layer after core asset adapters are established.

steps.name: SEC Official Evidence Adapter
steps.output: Filings, XBRL fundamentals, source freshness, company identity

steps.name: Daily Market Data Adapter
steps.output: Alpha Vantage raw daily OHLCV plus derived short-horizon market context; full raw series not published

steps.name: Stocks Decision Intelligence
steps.output: Explainable Market View, Decision Readiness, Fundamental Evidence, Market Structure, Decision Risk, Counter-Thesis, and AI Decision Reasoner; no BUY/SELL

steps.name: Stocks Watch, Timeline & Prospective Validation
steps.output: Frozen Stage 10C methodology and core engine, material-change alerts, append-only decision history, and Fresh OOS collection strictly after the 2026-08-18 freeze baseline

phases.name: Unified News Intelligence
phases.scope: Cross-asset source-normalized news and event intelligence
requirements: Licensed Reuters/Bloomberg only when approved access exists
No single headline may confirm a material decision
